full_prompt_en: A square ink-and-watercolor storybook illustration shows a woman crouching at an open doorway while several dogs gather around her on a pale stone step. The background is a worn cream wall with faint cracks, rectangular blocks, and loose brown stains. At the center right, a tall salmon-orange wooden door stands open, its narrow panels and dark metal hardware drawn with crisp, economical lines. The dark interior beyond the door frames two small dog faces, one partly hidden behind the other. The woman occupies the middle of the composition, bending forward from the threshold in a deep navy coat and soft blue-gray skirt. A rounded dark hat covers her hair, while her pale face turns down toward the animals. Her hands rest near her knees, close to the light-colored dog at the threshold. Across the lower foreground, dogs with different coats form a loose semicircle: a black shaggy dog approaches from the left, a white dog sits beside it, a tan-and-white dog faces the woman from the center, and a brown dog stands at the right. Their bodies are outlined with fine, irregular black strokes, with small patches of wash supplying fur color and shadow. The pale ground remains mostly open around their paws, so the playful grouping stays easy to read despite the many overlapping shapes. Short pen marks describe the doorframe, coat folds, ears, and rough stone; transparent watercolor leaves parts of the paper visible. Light is gentle and diffuse, brightening the outer wall, skirt, and dogs while the doorway recess stays dark. Warm orange and tan accents balance the cool navy and gray garments. The overall composition feels affectionate and informal, with the strong doorway rectangle holding together a lively cluster of figures at its base.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形钢笔线描与水彩的故事书插画描绘一名女子蹲在敞开的门口，几只狗围聚在浅色石阶上。背景是一面磨旧的乳白色墙，带有隐约裂纹、矩形石块和松散的棕色污痕。中央偏右，一扇高高的鲑橙色木门打开着，狭长门板与深色金属配件由清晰节省的线条勾出。门后的暗色室内框住两张小狗的脸，其中一张部分藏在另一张后。女子占据构图中部，从门槛向前弯身，穿深海军蓝外套与柔和蓝灰色裙子。圆润的深色帽子遮住头发，浅色面孔低头转向动物。她双手靠近膝盖，紧邻门槛处的浅色狗。下方前景里，不同毛色的狗形成松散半圆：左侧一只黑色蓬毛狗走近，白狗坐在旁边，中央一只棕白狗朝着女子，右侧一只棕狗站立。它们的身体由细而不规则的黑线描出，少量水彩色斑赋予毛色和阴影。浅色地面在狗爪周围保留较多空白，使这个活泼群组虽然形体重叠，仍容易辨认。短促钢笔痕迹描写门框、衣褶、耳朵和粗糙石头；透明水彩让部分纸面露出。光线温和柔散，点亮外墙、裙子和狗，门内凹处则保持深暗。暖橙与棕褐色重音平衡冷海军蓝和灰色衣物。整体构图亲切随意，强烈的门口矩形把底部活泼的人与动物群组维系在一起。
style_prompt_en: The storybook illustration combines fine, slightly broken pen contours with transparent watercolor washes on warm off-white paper. Line carries structure and small expressive details, while loose diluted color settles unevenly inside and sometimes beyond the outlines. Cream and pale gray leave generous breathing room around concentrated navy, brown, and salmon-orange shapes. Dark recesses provide local depth, but most forms remain shallow, clear, and gently overlapped. Diffuse daylight produces light wash shadows rather than strong modeled contrast. Dry stipples, brief hatching, and visible paper grain give surfaces a pleasantly worn tactile quality. A few strong rectangular shapes steady smaller irregular curves and figures, creating an informal yet legible rhythm. The overall effect is tender and observational, with hand-drawn variation more important than polished realism.
style_prompt_zh: 这种故事书插画将细而略有断续的钢笔轮廓与暖灰白纸上的透明水彩晕染结合。线条承担结构与小巧生动的细节，松散稀释的颜色则不均匀地停留在轮廓内，有时也漫出边缘。乳白和浅灰在集中出现的海军蓝、棕与鲑橙色形状周围留下宽裕空隙。深色凹处提供局部纵深，但多数形体保持浅平、清楚并温和叠压。柔散日光只产生浅水彩阴影，而非强烈塑形对比。干点、短排线和可见纸纹为表面增添愉快的磨旧触感。少量有力的矩形形状稳住更小的不规则曲线与形体，形成随意却清晰的节奏。整体效果温柔而富观察感，手绘变化比打磨光滑的写实更重要。
theme_en: A woman crouches in an open doorway among waiting dogs
theme_zh: 女子蹲在打开的门口，身边围着等待的狗
name: Cecil Aldin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
